## Notes

Squad (Mexico); first public release 0.7.3 on 2011-06-24; Steam early access 2013-03-20; 1.0 on 2015-04-27; Linux, macOS, Windows, PS4/PS5, Xbox; patched-conic orbits (no n-body); sandbox, science, and career modes with funds, reputation, contracts; joint strength limits; 3,000+ mods.
